patch_list: Hide AI Input Bar
Adds a setting to hide the shared AI input bar and its floating/Home containers throughout the app.
Hide Centre d’avantages
Adds an independent setting to hide the Centre d’avantages (Rewards Hub) Profile entry.
Hide Explorer Tab
Adds a setting to remove Explorer from navigation, with safe selection and fragment restoration.
Hide Home Plus
Adds a setting to hide the Home header Plus badge while keeping the separate add (+) button.
Hide Home Recommendations
Adds a setting to remove the Home Recommended card group, including its header and spacing.
Hide Intelligence Recommendations
Adds an independent setting to hide the Intelligence Recommended page.
Hide Tuya AI Web Version
Adds a setting to hide only the Tuya AI Web Version entry in Profile.

patch_list: Disable telemetry
Disables Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics and automatic page tracking. Works by turning off the app's own analytics feature flags.
Hide ads
Disables in-app ads: AdMob/PID banners and the Tuya marketing ad service. Works by turning off the app's own advertising feature flags.
Hide AI assistant

Hides the "Hey Tuya" AI assistant added in app 7.0 (the home AI bar, the device-panel floating ball and the B2-gated entry points). This is a runtime toggle: it can be turned on and off in the in-app "SmartLife Patches" settings screen (lo…
Hide home recommendations
Hides the "おすすめ" (Recommended) cards on the home screen. This is a runtime toggle in the in-app "SmartLife Patches" settings screen. Hidden by default.
SmartLife Patches settings
Adds two ways to open the in-app "SmartLife Patches" settings screen: long-press the settings button at the top of the profile tab, or long-press the toolbar of the app's Settings screen.
Spoof signature

Keeps the original APK signature visible to the app after re-signing, so the app's integrity self-check passes instead of showing "integrity check failed" and quitting, and so email/phone + password login keeps working. Enabled by default…
